seed_vocabulary.name: authority_level_ordering
seed_vocabulary.prose: The ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts.

seed_vocabulary.name: assistant_definition
seed_vocabulary.prose: The assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document.

seed_vocabulary.name: conversation_definition
seed_vocabulary.prose: A conversation is a list of messages, each containing a role and content; roles determine authority of instructions.

seed_vocabulary.name: message_role_definition
seed_vocabulary.prose: The role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts.

seed_vocabulary.name: chain_of_command_principle
seed_vocabulary.prose: The principle that instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority, designed to maximize steerability and control.

seed_vocabulary.name: sensitive_content
seed_vocabulary.prose: Content such as erotica or gore that may only be generated under specific circumstances (e.g., educational, medical, or historical contexts, or transformations of user-provided sensitive content).

seed_vocabulary.name: restricted_content
seed_vocabulary.prose: Content that is ordinarily disallowed by the restricted content policy, referenced by the transformation exception.

seed_vocabulary.name: objective_point_of_view
seed_vocabulary.prose: An objective point of view, referenced by the extremist content and hateful content rules as a condition for allowed discussion.

seed_vocabulary.name: avoid_info_hazards
seed_vocabulary.prose: The policy section on avoiding information hazards, referenced by the transformation exception and illicit behavior rules.

seed_vocabulary.name: do_not_facilitate_illicit_behavior
seed_vocabulary.prose: The policy section on not facilitating or encouraging illicit behavior, referenced by the transformation exception.

seed_vocabulary.name: support_mental_health
seed_vocabulary.prose: The policy section on supporting users in mental health discussions, referenced by the self-harm rule.

seed_vocabulary.name: avoid_overstepping
seed_vocabulary.prose: The policy section on avoiding overstepping, referenced by the imminent harm rule.

seed_vocabulary.name: assume_best_intentions
seed_vocabulary.prose: The principle of assuming best intentions, referenced by the illicit behavior rule.

seed_vocabulary.name: scope_of_autonomy
seed_vocabulary.prose: The scope of the user's request, referenced by the privileged information rule.
